stories.story_fr: Ametek a acquis LKC Technologies, fournisseur de technologies innovantes pour le diagnostic ophtalmique.
stories.story_en: Ametek acquired LKC Technologies, a provider of innovative technologies for ophthalmic diagnosis.
stories.quote: AMETEK, Inc. (NYSE AME) today announced the acquisition of LKC Technologies, a leading provider of innovative technologies to enable the effective diagnosis and management of ophthalmic conditions.

stories.story_fr: LKC Technologies s'intègre à l'activité Ultra Precision Technologies Reichert d'Ametek, élargissant le portefeuille ophtalmique.
stories.story_en: LKC Technologies fits into Ametek's Ultra Precision Technologies Reichert business, expanding the ophthalmic product portfolio.
stories.quote: LKC Technologies is an excellent strategic fit with our Ultra Precision Technologies Reichert business, providing attractive market expansion opportunities and creating a broader ophthalmic product portfolio.

stories.story_fr: Le modèle de croissance d'Ametek vise une croissance à deux chiffres du bénéfice par action sur le cycle économique.
stories.story_en: Ametek's growth model targets double-digit percentage growth in earnings per share over the business cycle.
stories.quote: AMETEK's objective is double-digit percentage growth in earnings per share over the business cycle and a superior return on total capital.
